title: 2 nabbed, P260,000 ‘smuggled’ cigarettes seized in Surigao del Sur

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Police arrested two individuals, including a minor, and seized 400 reams of suspected smuggled cigarettes valued at P260,000 following a high-speed chase in Tandag City, Surigao del Sur, on Sunday, Nov. 15. Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon, director of the Police Regional Office in Caraga (PRO-13), identified one of the suspects as alias “Abdul,” 45, a businessman from Barangay Villa Kananga in Butuan City, and his companion, a 16-year-old boy.
